note: Source-only audit of every MPN-bearing passive placement across the product board set: the MPN's nominal value (decoded from the Yageo/Vishay/KEMET/Murata/Samsung/Fenghua/Bourns ordering codes) was compared with the placed Value property. The one flagged row (RC0603FR-072K2L) is a decoder artifact: Yageo '2K2' means 2.2 kohm and the placed value is 2.2 kohm, so it is NOT a mismatch. Result: 0 real mismatches in 18 checked rows; 2 rows carried free-text values ('4.7 uF bulk reservation', MPN used as value) that the decoder did not parse but that agree with the MPN by inspection. Finding: board Value strings use four notations (SI prefix, plain ohms, scientific, free text), which a BOM generator must normalise.
